task: Hide Elasticsearch-dependent retrieval features (Knowledge Bases, Datasources, Code Indexing) from the backend when RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=none, via a new config key, three runtime customer-config components, conditional router registration, two boot-hazard fixes, agent-toolkit/catalogue gating, and a startup capability banner.

key_reasoning.reason: Six-plus components across four layers: Config (config.py new key + customer_config.py three runtime components), Service (toolkit_service.py chat-time gating, tools_info_service.py catalogue filtering), REST API (main.py app assembly, conditional index.router registration, AC27 startup banner), and Datasource ingestion (google_doc_datasource_processor.py boot fix). Bumped from XL to XXL by two red flags: touches core shared utilities (the customer_config runtime-component mechanism and the ElasticSearchClient chokepoint) and affects multiple agent toolkits/chat runtimes (KB and code toolkits reached from assistant, a2a, ide, and workflow_executions routers).

Two import-time Elasticsearch boot hazards must both be fixed (google_doc_datasource_processor.py class-body client construction, and main.py's StateImportService().import_indexes() at module scope) or the container cannot start at all under RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=none. No existing test precedent for asserting conditional router registration in a module-scope FastAPI app with no create_app() factory. A subtle mock-default hazard (@patch(...config) installs a truthy MagicMock) could make new guard tests silently pass with retrieval reported as enabled. Two AC29 gaps (tool catalogue in tools_info_service.py, chat runtime in add_context_tools) require genuinely new feature-gating code with no existing pattern to copy — held at L rather than XL because the whole feature sits behind a single config flag and is fully reversible.

Roughly six core implementation files (config.py, customer_config.py, main.py, google_doc_datasource_processor.py, toolkit_service.py, tools_info_service.py) plus three-plus test files needing modification (five exact len() assertions break in test_customer_config.py per the analysis's R-4, plus toolkit-service and customer-config-service tests) and two-to-three new test files (a router-fencing test needs a new test-design approach). Spans four-plus directories: configs/, rest_api/, datasource/google_doc/, service/tools/, mirrored under tests/.

Config, Service (toolkit assembly + tool catalogue), REST API (app assembly/router registration), and Agent-Tool (KB/code toolkit gating) — a cross-cutting feature-flag capability spread across four layers, though no DB schema change or migration is involved.
